dedupe_keys.name: three lithium ion cell chemistries under controlled discharge tests

description: This deposit provides controlled-discharge measurements for lithium-ion cells with NCA, NMC and LFP cathode chemistries. The producer documents an Arbin system applying a set current after a constant-current/constant-voltage charging protocol, while voltage and surface temperature are recorded in a thermal chamber. Mendeley’s file inventory contains 334 files, including Excel measurements and MATLAB analysis scripts labelled by chemistry, discharge rate and temperatures of 5, 25 and 35 degrees Celsius. Public access is free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is laboratory cell tests, not an operational battery fleet; the repository does not establish a common calendar period or sample interval. Voltage cutoff also differs between chemistries, limiting naive comparisons of delivered capacity. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating discharge and thermal behaviour in battery simulations. model-system-advisor-model-sam is a related project-level storage simulator, requiring translation of cell parameters. Neither the measurement files nor analysis scripts were downloaded or executed.
